propositions: The Data Center backend needs a TicketTransport built on pycontribs/jira, confined to an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra and lazily imported so import rebar stays dependency-free.
Auth uses a Personal Access Token read env-only from JIRA_PAT passed as token_auth, with malformed config failing loudly rather than degrading to env-only.
Each transport method must return rebar's raw payload shapes rather than jira.Issue objects, verified against the shared verified-fake shape contract for both fake and live clients.
TLS certificate verification must never be disabled: the transport passes options['verify'] as True or a ca_bundle path, and allow_insecure only affects the URL-scheme check, not cert verification.
The DC backend must self-register via an import in adapters/__init__.py so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves, else it raises BackendRegistryError at runtime.
Retry policy must mirror acli_rest exactly, retrying transient connectivity faults including builtin TimeoutError with 2s/5s backoff while never retrying HTTP errors.
